# Study 5: weekly momentum with OTM options (auto-generated by `run_otm.py`)

395 weeks 2019-04-05 -> 2026-11-13. Up week -> buy call K=S(1+x), down week -> buy put K=S(1-x), weekly expiry, held to Friday 08:00 UTC. Priced at REAL Deribit smile (buyer side; pooled buyer premium 0.2 vol pts). R = return on premium spent per trade. Flat size, no martingale.
